{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: windows driver tests

# Exercises the Windows kernel driver analysis against real compiler output and
# real signed drivers, neither of which the unit tests or the LOLDrivers harness
# can reach: the unit tests use hand-written assembly, and the LOLDrivers dataset
# publishes import lists rather than binaries.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'blint/lib/driver_ioctl.py'
      - 'blint/lib/binary_reviews.py'
      - 'blint/data/annotations/review_drivers_win.yml'
      - 'contrib/win-driver-fixture/**'
      - '.github/workflows/drivertests.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions: {}

jobs:
  build-fixture:
    # Builds the driver-shaped fixture whose control codes are known ahead of
    # time. MSVC is preinstalled on the runner; no WDK is needed.
    name: build driver fixture
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # build.cmd resolves the MSVC environment itself through vswhere. The
      # runner image moves between Visual Studio versions - windows-latest now
      # carries VS 2026, whose install path is ...\\18\\Enterprise rather than
      # ...\\2022\\Enterprise - so the toolset must be located, not assumed.
      - name: Build fixture
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          mkdir out
          call contrib\\win-driver-fixture\\build.cmd %CD%\\out\\blint_test_driver.sys
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: blint-test-driver
          path: out/blint_test_driver.sys
          if-no-files-found: error

  verify-recovery:
    # The analysis runs on Linux because nyxstone, and therefore disassembly, is
    # only installed there (the Windows job in bintests.yml uses
    # --without=extended).
    name: verify IOCTL recovery
    needs: build-fixture
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c  # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: blint-test-driver
          path: out
      - name: Linux packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev llvm-18 llvm-18-dev
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install blint
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install poetry
          poetry install --all-groups --all-extras
        env:
          NYXSTONE_LLVM_PREFIX: /usr/lib/llvm-18
      - name: Verify recovery against ground truth
        run: |
          poetry run python contrib/win-driver-fixture/verify_recovery.py \
            out/blint_test_driver.sys | tee recovery.txt
      - name: Summarise
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo '### Driver IOCTL recovery'
            echo '```'
            cat recovery.txt
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  inbox-driver-precision:
    # A false-positive sweep over the signed Microsoft drivers already present on
    # the runner. LOLDrivers measures recall only - every sample in it is known
    # vulnerable - so it cannot tell you how noisy a rule is. These can, and the
    # binaries never leave the runner, so nothing is redistributed.
    #
    # Import- and string-based rules only: no nyxstone on Windows, so the
    # disassembly-dependent rules stay silent here by construction.
    name: inbox driver false-positive sweep
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Install blint
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install poetry
          poetry install --without=extended --all-extras
      - name: Sweep inbox drivers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          poetry run python contrib/win-driver-fixture/inbox_sweep.py \
            --drivers-dir "C:/Windows/System32/drivers" --limit 250 | tee sweep.txt
      - name: Summarise
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo '### Inbox driver false-positive sweep'
            echo '```'
            cat sweep.txt
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs Python jobs that reinstall dependencies (poetry install) on every PR/run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) supports caching dependency downloads using a lockfile-keyed cache to cut repeated fetch time while preserving all tests. The repository has poetry.lock and pyproject.toml, and both Python jobs use poetry, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include a lockfile. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on runner.os plus poetry.lock in the Ubuntu verify-recovery job (where ~/.cache/pip is pip's actual cache directory) reuses downloaded wheels across runs without changing test coverage, permissions, or adding network/privileged access. The Windows job is left unchanged because pip's Windows cache directory differs from ~/.cache/pip, so caching that path there would be ineffective.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
